scope: Priority A only: twelve multi-provider observed competition entries with country context.
interpretation: External official competition evidence supports the public competition identity and season context. It does not prove that provider-specific IDs or season IDs refer to the same canonical competition or season.

entries.name: Bundesliga

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 Bundesliga calendar; start 28 August 2026.
DFL competition regulations identify Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga as licensed leagues.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Cross-provider 2026 start-year overlap for football-data.org, OpenFootball and OpenLigaDB; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 but lacks parsed start year.

entries.name: Premier League

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 club list and confirms the Championship is the second tier below the Premier League.
Official 2026/27 fixture list; includes Aston Villa v Sunderland on 21 November and Hull City v Brighton & Hove Albion on 22 November.
Official November amendment notice; confirms the two reviewed fixture pairings and states all listed kick-offs are GMT and 15:00 unless otherwise stated.

entries.provider_season_evidence: OpenFootball and OpenLigaDB share 2026 start-year evidence; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 without parsed start year.

entries.name: Ligue 1

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 Ligue 1 calendar, season dates, matchday structure and scheduled fixtures.
Official announcement explicitly refers to the 18 clubs of Ligue 1 for 2026/27.
Official LFP French-language calendar announcement dated 10 June 2026.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Bzzoiro's 2026/27 season label is explicit; OpenFootball's 2026-27 label and football-data.org's 2026-08-22 date are consistent with the official season start but do not prove provider season-ID equivalence. Bzzoiro has 34 timezone-aware observations, 9 unique fixtures and all 18 official team names in its bounded sample. OpenFootball has 6,120 observations and 306 unique fixtures, but its kickoff values are local/date-only without timezone and some are missing. football-data.org has 10 timezone-aware observations covering 12 teams, but country is missing on all 10. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: Championship

external_evidence.supports: EFL identifies the Championship as one of its three divisions and describes its regular-season structure.
Official EFL Championship competition page and league table.

entries.provider_season_evidence: No shared parsed season start year in current provider snapshots.

entries.name: 2. Bundesliga

external_evidence.supports: Official calendar distinguishes Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2, with Bundesliga 2 beginning 7 August 2026.
DFL regulations identify 2. Bundesliga as a licensed league.

entries.provider_season_evidence: OpenLigaDB season year 2026; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 without parsed start year.

entries.name: Serie A

external_evidence.supports: Official Serie A 2026/27 season dates; distinguishes Serie A from Coppa Italia.
Official announcement identifies 20 clubs, 38 matchdays and 380 matches, and gives the season dates.
Official 2026/27 fixture-list publication dated 5 June 2026.
Official Matchday 12 fixture listing for 21–23 November 2026.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Both source labels normalize descriptively to 2026/27 (Bzzoiro 'Serie A 26/27'; OpenFootball '2026-27'). Bzzoiro has 21 raw observations, 9 unique fixture IDs, and 18 observed teams; OpenFootball has 7,600 raw observations, 380 unique fixtures, and all 20 official teams, but its sampled kickoffs are local-time values without timezone. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: MLS
entries.external_competition_type: men's top-tier professional league spanning the United States and Canada
